_comment: Scoped permission allowlist for the unattended 8 PM Daily Posts run (claude -p, headless). Covers ONLY what the /daily-posts skill needs: the grader, the state builder, the check scripts it writes under scratch/posts_checks/, the lint, the delivery check, and file read/write. No web tools (every claim is computed from local history), no git, no Slack, no broker. The deny list hard-blocks secret files: a scoped session that writes files is still an exfiltration path if credentials ever reach it. Grep deliberately absent (dumps file contents, cannot be path-scoped).
